label.purpose: Tally labels, table headers, nav tabs, badge text — tracked uppercase.

data.purpose: Scan output only: filenames, code, hashes, timestamps.

shadows.name: seal-ring
shadows.purpose: Stamped-edge character on the wax-seal disposition badge. Not an elevation cue.

components.name: Wax-Seal Badge
components.description: Full-pill risk disposition badge; dark ink text on every tier's fill, inset stamped-edge ring.
components.css: .ds-seal-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.28rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #120d0a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(18,13,10,0.25); } .ds-seal-critical { background-color: #cf5f3f; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ribbon { background-color: #c9a24a; border: 1px solid #c9a24a; color: #120d0a; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ribbon:hover, .ds-btn-ribbon:focus-visible { background-color: #d9b25a; outline: 2px solid #d9b25a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Tally Cell
components.description: One divided cell inside the bound ledger-strip summary — dot + colored value, never a standalone card.
components.css: .ds-ledger-cell { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-right: 1px solid #4a3b2c; background: #241c17; } .ds-tally-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #a8987e; } .ds-tally-label::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #cf5f3f; } .ds-tally-value { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 700; color: #cf5f3f; }

components.name: Ledger Nav Tab
components.description: Top navigation tab; underline-active on desktop, background-tint-active on mobile stacked layout (never a colored side border).
components.css: .ds-ledger-tab { color: #a8987e; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.4rem 0.1rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-ledger-tab:hover { color: #ede3d0; } .ds-is-active { color: #c9a24a; border-bottom-color: #c9a24a; }

components.name: Ledger Book Table
components.description: Container for the repo register table.
components.css: .ds-ledger-book { background-color: #241c17; border: 1px solid #4a3b2c; border-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-table-ledger th { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #a8987e; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a3b2c; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; }

narrative.overview: MalDet reads as a cellarmaster's ledger, not a security-vendor's dashboard: every scanned repository is a bottle under review, and a risk verdict is a control earned across five criteria, not a status pill assigned by a template. The system was chosen deliberately against the category's two ruts — the neon-terminal 'hacker' dashboard and the sterile white compliance console — through a directed roll against a grounded shortlist of visual worlds drawn from the audience's actual scene: a solo developer, alone at their desk, deciding whether to let a stranger's code in.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cellar-ink ground with tonal layering, no shadows
A single wax-toned risk scale carries all semantic color; UI copy shows the plain severity words the audience already scans for
One brass-foil accent, used sparingly and never reused for a risk signal
Workhorse system sans throughout; no display serif imported
Monospace reserved for real scan data, not yet exercised on the Dashboard

rules.name: The Token-Copy Split Rule
rules.body: Internal token/class names use the world's vocabulary (cleared/minor/flagged/contested/rejected); rendered UI copy shows Safe/Low/Medium/High/Critical by explicit user decision. Do not reconcile these into matching names.

rules.name: The Brand-Never-Signals-Risk Rule
rules.body: Brass Foil must never coincide with a risk-scale value.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation is tonal layering plus hairline, never a shadow; the badge's inset ring is the sole exception and exists for material character, not depth.

rules.name: The Bound-Strip Rule
rules.body: The dashboard summary is one bordered strip with internal dividers, never five separate same-size cards.

dos: Do keep the risk scale semantic-only.
Do keep Brass Foil hue-distinct from every risk-scale color.
Do use the wax-seal pill and the bound ledger-strip as the system's signature devices.
Do reserve monospace for actual scan data.
Do verify new color pairings against WCAG AA before shipping — this system's badges were tuned specifically because a first draft failed contrast.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism.
Don't introduce a second decorative accent alongside Brass Foil.
Don't reuse a risk-scale color for brand/UI-chrome purposes, or vice versa.
Don't use a colored side border as a category or state signal anywhere.
Don't rename the internal risk-tier tokens to match the displayed copy, or vice versa.
